title: State of population in the cities and municipalities of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, January 1st 1840, as a result of the last general census
descriptions: The dataset is based on the population census of the Netherlands of 1840. Content: images of the publication, searchable pdf file of the text sections, excel files with data entered from the published tables and from the additions and corrections issued as an appendix to the census of 1859.
